description: CONCERN 4 + FORMATIONS (per approved design, Option C). Browsing NEVER runs inside invoke(). (a) Registry formation support: add SkillMeta.formation read from flat `formation:` frontmatter (default DEFAULT_FORMATION). (b) Planner keystone fix: thread discovered strategy names (plugin_loader.strategy_names()) into select_strategy and match the LLM choice against that discovered set with LONGEST-MATCH-FIRST (so a discovered folder is selectable and defensive_press is not misread as defensive). (c) Formation rendering in the position prompt as an O(1) dict lookup that rides the strategy choice — no second model call, stays inside the 3.5s tick budget established by FEAT-002. (d) Add flat `formation:` frontmatter + a Formation-posture line to the three built-in strategies. (e) A new OFFLINE generator+validator script discover_strategy.py that writes a validated src/plugins/<name>/ folder, never imported by the runtime. Depends on FEAT-002 (the tick budget it must respect) and FEAT-001.
steps: TEST FIRST (registry): extend tests/test_registry.py — a tmp_path skill.md with flat `formation: 3-0-1` -> SkillMeta.formation == '3-0-1'; absent or folded/malformed formation -> DEFAULT_FORMATION. Use registry.discover(plugins_dir=tmp).

In src/agents/players/constants.py add ALLOWED_FORMATIONS = ('0-4-0','1-0-3','1-1-2','1-1-1-1','1-2-1','2-0-2','2-1-1','3-0-1') and DEFAULT_FORMATION = '1-1-1-1' (mirror of .kiro/steering/game-domain.md). In src/plugins/registry.py add `formation: str` to SkillMeta and read fm.get('formation', DEFAULT_FORMATION) in _load_meta (avoid a circular import — read the default lazily or mirror the literal; prefer constants as the single source).

TEST FIRST (planner selection): extend tests/test_planner.py — with a known set including a 4th name 'high_press_counter' and a fake agent_factory naming it, select_strategy returns 'high_press_counter'; with known=('defensive','defensive_press') and LLM text naming 'defensive_press', select_strategy returns 'defensive_press' (longest-match-first), NOT 'defensive'. Keep the existing hint/rule tests green.

Add plugin_loader.strategy_names() -> tuple(registry.strategies().keys()). Change planner.select_strategy(..., known: tuple[str,...]=constants.STRATEGIES) and _parse_choice(text, known) to match `known` sorted by descending name length (longest-match-first). Hint path validates `hint if hint in known else DEFAULT_STRATEGY`. rule_based_strategy stays built-ins only.
In src/agents/players/unified_agent.py compute known_strategies = plugin_loader.strategy_names() at register() alongside skill_descriptions and pass it into planner.select_strategy(...) in invoke().

TEST FIRST (plugin_loader formation): extend tests/test_plugin_loader.py — build_system_prompt renders a Formation-posture line for the chosen strategy's declared formation AND still contains the untouched guardrails.md text; strategy_names() returns the discovered set.

In src/agents/players/plugin_loader.py: look up the chosen strategy's SkillMeta.formation in build_system_prompt and have load_skill_prompt substitute a {formation} token plus a one-line posture string (default DEFAULT_FORMATION when the strategy is unknown, reusing the existing default-strategy/mid.md fallbacks). Do not alter guardrails composition.

Add flat `formation:` frontmatter to src/plugins/{balanced,aggressive,defensive}/skill.md (balanced 1-2-1, aggressive 1-0-3, defensive 3-0-1) and a one-line 'Formation posture' section referencing {formation} to each of their gk/def/mid/fwd1/fwd2.md (one coherent same-pattern edit across the three folders). Verify via the registry + plugin_loader tests.

TEST FIRST (discovery): add tests/test_discover_strategy.py with a STUBBED research callable. Good spec -> written to src/plugins/<name>/ (6 files) via an OS-temp staging dir then moved. Each bad spec rejected with NOTHING moved: missing file, empty description, bad/folded formation, name colliding or substring-overlapping an existing strategy, injected/system-override content, unsafe path (.. or separators). Validator must parse frontmatter via registry._parse_frontmatter on the ACTUAL bytes. Fully offline.

Create src/agents/players/discover_strategy.py (NEVER imported by the runtime): an injected web-search/Strands agent (default lazily built, injected in tests) proposes a strategy spec; validate structural (exactly skill.md+gk/def/mid/fwd1/fwd2.md), frontmatter via registry._parse_frontmatter on the bytes to write (name ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,30}$, type==skill, non-empty description, formation in ALLOWED_FORMATIONS written as a flat scalar), name non-collision + substring-disjoint vs registry.strategies(), path-safety, content-safety (each position file has the mandatory JSON-array response line, only VALID_COMMANDS/the 4 tactical tools, no system-prompt-override phrasing/URLs/extra code fences). Write to $env:TEMP, validate, move into src/plugins/<name>/ only on full success; exit non-zero otherwise. Nothing written to the repo on failure.
acceptance_criteria: SkillMeta.formation is parsed from flat frontmatter and defaults to DEFAULT_FORMATION; `uv run pytest -q tests/test_registry.py` passes.
select_strategy can SELECT a discovered strategy name and longest-match-first prevents substring collisions; `uv run pytest -q tests/test_planner.py` passes.
build_system_prompt renders the formation posture line while leaving guardrails.md untouched; `uv run pytest -q tests/test_plugin_loader.py` passes.
discover_strategy.py validates and writes a good spec and rejects every bad spec with nothing written; it is never imported by the runtime; `uv run pytest -q tests/test_discover_strategy.py` passes.
No browsing/network/model call is added to unified_agent.invoke(); formation selection is an O(1) lookup.
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_registry.py tests/test_planner.py tests/test_plugin_loader.py tests/test_discover_strategy.py
findings: DONE. Suite 67 -> 93 passing via `uv run pytest -q`. Both verification commands pass. (a) REGISTRY: SkillMeta gained `formation: str`; _load_meta reads fm.get('formation', DEFAULT) and falls back to DEFAULT when the parsed value is not in the allowed set (so a folded/malformed formation defaults). To avoid a circular import, registry mirrors the literals as module-level _DEFAULT_FORMATION='1-1-1-1' + _ALLOWED_FORMATIONS (comment points to constants as the single source). (b) CONSTANTS: added ALLOWED_FORMATIONS (8 shapes, mirror of game-domain.md) + DEFAULT_FORMATION='1-1-1-1'. (c) PLANNER: select_strategy gained `known: tuple=STRATEGIES`; _parse_choice(text, known) now matches sorted(known, key=len, reverse=True) = LONGEST-MATCH-FIRST so 'defensive_press' is not misread as 'defensive' and a discovered folder name is selectable. hint path validates `hint if hint in known else DEFAULT_STRATEGY`. rule_based_strategy stays built-ins only (unchanged). (d) PLUGIN_LOADER: added strategy_names()->tuple(registry.strategies().keys()); load_skill_prompt now also substitutes a {formation} token (meta.formation when known, else DEFAULT_FORMATION for an unknown strategy) via literal str.replace (NOT .format, so the {{...}} JSON examples are untouched); guardrails composition unchanged. (e) UNIFIED_AGENT: register() computes known_strategies=plugin_loader.strategy_names() and threads known=known_strategies into planner.select_strategy in invoke(). NO browsing/network/model call added to invoke(); formation is an O(1) dict lookup riding the strategy choice. (f) STRATEGY FOLDERS: added flat `formation:` frontmatter (balanced 1-2-1, aggressive 1-0-3, defensive 3-0-1) + a '## Formation posture' section referencing {formation} to all 15 position files. (g) NEW OFFLINE TOOL src/agents/players/discover_strategy.py (NEVER imported by the runtime; unified_agent does not import it): generate(name, research, plugins_dir) runs an INJECTED research callable -> {filename: content}, validates (structure = exactly skill.md+gk/def/mid/fwd1/fwd2.md; frontmatter via registry._parse_frontmatter on the bytes: name ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,30}$ AND == requested name, type==skill, non-empty description, formation in ALLOWED_FORMATIONS AND written as a FLAT scalar verified by regex on raw bytes since the parser normalizes a folded `>`; name path-safety; collision + substring-overlap vs registry.strategies(); content-safety per position file: must contain 'JSON array', no system-override phrasing, no URLs, no extra code fences, every "commandType":"X" value in VALID_COMMANDS, bare UPPER_SNAKE verbs must be a VALID_COMMAND / tactical tool / allowlisted non-command word), stages to tempfile.mkdtemp() ($env:TEMP), re-parses the staged folder via registry._load_meta, and shutil.move's into src/plugins/<name>/ ONLY on full success; raises SpecError (ValueError) with NOTHING written otherwise; main() exits non-zero on rejection. The default research agent (_default_research) is built lazily and ONLY in main() (imports strands + strands_tools.http_request for browser/web access), so importing the module pulls in no strands/network. NEW TESTS: tests/test_discover_strategy.py (13: good spec written + every bad spec rejected with nothing moved), + registry/planner/plugin_loader extensions. E2E BASELINE (per the parent notification's non-negotiable acceptance criterion): tests/test_e2e_tick.py (4 tests) wires the REAL planner+plugin_loader through the REAL unified_agent.invoke() with fake model+tools injected via agent_factory + a monkeypatched fake MCP gateway (_inject_tools patches unified_agent._gateway_transport + unified_agent.MCPClient), asserting the 5-point tick: (1) state-aware selection (losing-late->aggressive, winning-late->defensive), (2) formation resolved via O(1) lookup and present in the composed system prompt (value in ALLOWED_FORMATIONS), (3) a tactical tool offered AND used through the tools path, (4) exactly one VALID command tagged teamId/playerId, (5) INFINITE-LOOP SAFETY: the turns cap (MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS=2) stops a would-be-looping tool-calling model at exactly 2 tool calls, and a hanging model trips the 3.5s wall-clock timeout (patched small) and falls back to the deterministic rule-based command well under 1s. All offline, no AWS/strands/network. CONFIRMED (carried from FEAT-002, unchanged): Strands per-invocation cap is `agent(prompt, limits={'turns': 2})` (keyword-only Limits TypedDict; trip => graceful stop_reason 'limit_turns', no exception); BedrockModel kwargs = model_id, boto_client_config (botocore Config), guardrail_id, guardrail_version. NOT YET CONFIRMED (remain for FEAT-004): the aws-cdk-lib CfnGuardrail property names (Bedrock guardrail creation in CDK) and any live read-only deploy confirmations — no AWS calls were made in this FEAT (all offline).
